scope: Descriptive cross-game comparison, not a causal A/B. New human Huanyu is one 296-point game with incomplete historical resource logging; AI is the full24 frozen candidate games using enhanced company rules. Credit+energy ignores cards/publicity/data and changing action mix, so actions/spend is not a universal efficiency or scoring metric. Non-income after recurring aid still includes trades and excludes neither initial advantages nor discounts/passives. No model parameter is fitted from this ratio.

blueTiming.scope: Fixed paired full suite. Acquisition comes from blue-tech selection and placement logs, reconciled against actual ledger tech IDs; the last remaining board slot auto-places and is inferred from the three preceding placements. Bonus type follows tile identity, not board slot. Resource receipts use the existing structured ledger. Only standard analyze decisions are inspected for currently available blue resource placement; card/effect analyses are excluded. A skipped available placement is an opportunity for investigation, not proof that pre-filling is optimal; spending data has displacement costs.

findings: Human Huanyu takes blue1 at R2T5 and blue2 at R3T11, yet earns6C/4E. Thus first-round ownership alone does not explain the gap; repeat throughput after acquisition must be evaluated.
AI Huanyu candidate has72 standard analyses and zero available blue1/blue2 placements at those decisions. This does not support a general force-place-before-analyze patch.

Confirmed fourth blue technology auto-placement has no separate slot-choice log. Acquisition was reconciled with ledger tech IDs for every AI seat, and the sole remaining slot inferred from the prior three.

The observed45 versus28.375 main-action difference factors into visible credit-energy throughput and actions per spend; this is arithmetic on reported counts and cannot establish causality or compensate missing human entries.
